name: XV8 Crisis Battlesuit Shas'ui

bonuses.name: Manoeuvring Jet Packs
bonuses.text: The XV8 can make a controlled descent from any height and never takes damage from falling. The XV8 has a Long Jump and High Jump distance of 10m and can make these jumps as part of their movement without making Athletics (S) Tests.

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 2 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Drone Controller
bonuses.text: : The XV8 can control up to two Tactical Support Drones.

bonuses.name: Twin-linked Weapons
bonuses.text: When the XV8 is equipped with two weapons of the same type, it can fire both weapons once on its turn without suffering Multi-Attack DN penalties.

bonuses.name: XV8 Powered Battlesuit
bonuses.text: The XV8 Crisis Battlesuit increases the wearers Strength, Toughness, Agility, and Initiative Attribute Bonuses by +4. These increases have been applied to this statblock.

abilities.text: See Crisis Battlesuit Variations for more information.

abilities.name: Jet Pack Jump
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. The XV25 gains a Speed of 12 (Fly) for its turn.

options.name: Crisis Battlesuit Variations
options.text: An XV8 Crisis Battlesuit has 4 Wargear slots. Each XV8 Crisis Battlesuit can have 1 of the following: Counterfire Defence System, Early Warning Override, Multi-tracker, Shield Generator, Target Lock, Velocity Tracker. And can install any of the following on their remaining Wargear slots: Installing multiple instances of the same Wargear does not increase the effectiveness of that Wargear or stack the effects, unless they are Twin-Linked Weapons. Crisis Suit Wargear Options follow (p.165).

abilities.name: Airbursting Fragmentation Projector
abilities.text: This weapon can target anyone in range, regardless of visibility.

abilities.name: Counterfire Defence System
abilities.text: As a reflexive action, spend 1 Ruin to increase Defence by +4

abilities.name: Early Warning Override
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. As a reflexive action, make a ranged attack.

abilities.name: Multi-Tracker
abilities.text: Whenever this Threat targets a Mob with a ranged attack Test, they gain +4 bonus dice.

abilities.name: Target Lock
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. This Threat ignores the effects of cover until the end of its turn.

abilities.name: Velocity Tracker
abilities.text: Whenever this Threat targets an individual that is flying with a ranged attack Test, they gain +4 bonus dice.

note: Print errors copied: Jet Pack Jump names the XV25; Drone Controller text starts with a stray colon. The Crisis Suit Wargear Options (p.165) are kept as one variant; the T'au Flamer prints no Salvo or AP.
